title: Clawd X Digest
summary: GPT-5.5 Instant Rollout: OpenAI releases GPT-5.5 Instant, focusing on better intent alignment, constraint adherence, and local/shopping recommendation features.
Figma Valuation Debate: Despite consistently beating revenue targets post-IPO, Figma's stock is down 85%, triggering debates on whether AI design tools have dampended long-term growth expectations.
Apple's Secret Prototypes: For Apple's 50th anniversary, Tim Cook gave a tour of Apple's secret hardware archive, showcasing five decades of prototype history including never-before-seen devices.
Crisis in Venezuela: Reports filter out of Venezuela indicating a massive humanitarian crisis with unconfirmed reports of up to 10,000 casualties.
World Cup Brackets & Kane's Curse: Analysts evaluate Morocco's grueling path in the knockout stage, while a Ghanaian spiritualist claims to have lifted the curse on striker Harry Kane.

items.title: @OpenAI: GPT-5.5 Instant Launched
items.body: OpenAI rolled out GPT-5.5 Instant to paid users, featuring enhanced intent understanding, better constraint handling, and cohesive local/shopping recommendations. It rolls out to free users tomorrow.

items.title: @ansonlin: Figma Stock Valuation Debate
items.body: A discussion on why Figma's stock has declined 85% despite beating revenue projections every quarter post-IPO, highlighting market skepticism and the threat of AI design tools like Claude Design.

items.title: @WSJ: Inside Apple's Secret Prototype Archive
items.body: To mark Apple's 50th anniversary, Tim Cook took the WSJ inside a secret archive of prototypes and early hardware, detailing the story of five decades in one room including tech Cook himself had never seen.

items.title: @specs: Pre-orders Open for SPECS AR Glasses
items.body: Augmented reality startup SPECS has opened pre-orders for its smart glasses, designed to make spatial computing feel more natural and human-centric.

items.title: @RyanGirdusky: Devastating Casualties Reported in Venezuela
items.body: Unconfirmed reports out of Venezuela suggest a major unfolding tragedy with reports of up to 10,000 casualties, sparking deep concern and prayers on social platforms.

items.title: @MinMin89485072: Japan PM Announces First Wave of Countermeasures
items.body: Reports state that Japan has launched its first wave of counter-responses to regional economic and geopolitical disputes, marking a potential escalation in East Asian relations.

items.title: @PatsKam: World Cup Tourism and US Cost of Living Debates
items.body: A debate on ticket pricing and standard of living, questioning how international fans from developing countries can afford $5,000 World Cup tickets while many average Americans feel economically strained.

items.title: @Mawzen20: Ronaldo's Underrated 800-Goal Milestone
items.body: Football fans debate why Cristiano Ronaldo's record of 800 goals in 500 matches isn't receiving more active media recognition, emphasizing its historical scale.

items.title: @MessiahYaniss16: Morocco's Tough World Cup Bracket Path
items.body: An analysis of the FIFA World Cup knockout matchups showing a grueling path for Morocco after finishing second, lining them up against Netherlands, Mexico, France, and Spain.

items.title: @iMiaSanMia: Harry Kane Curse Lifted by Spiritualist
items.body: Ghanaian spiritualist Nana Kwaku Bonsam claims to have removed the 'curse' he previously placed on Harry Kane to prevent him from scoring against Ghana, wishing him luck in future matches.

items.title: @BayernPapa: Kane's Depressing Contrast in Midfield Support
items.body: Fans point out the stark contrast in creative midfield support for Harry Kane between his club squad (Bayern Munich) and his international national team teammates.

items.title: @JoshuaMMKR: World Cup Seattle Attendance Anomalies
items.body: Spectators express insouciance and skepticism over a packed 70,000-person Seattle stadium for a midday Bosnia-Herzegovina vs. Qatar match, questioning if tickets were given away.
